title: ERP contribution to subsequent social choice

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Historical developer controls remain scoped engineering evidence; this revision runs no model and does not turn source inspection into a performance result.
excluded_claims: Same-row source-paper regression reproduction is calibration for a different temporal endpoint.
No causal ERP contribution, prospective online availability, or independent ERP-trial identity claim.
Seven exposed development people do not establish population confirmation.

disposition_reason: The source scores 816 next-round choices from seven exposed development people and retains descriptive matched-view assessment. This is a genuine behavioral prediction target, but the offline ERP join and historical prefix controller do not establish independently aligned online EEG or the original full-cohort question.

scientific_target.question: Do the provided offline ERP features improve prediction of the next recorded choice beyond the completed behavioral prefix under matched frozen procedures?
scientific_target.known_answer: Next consecutive round accept/reject in the same five-round partner episode: 0 accept, 1 reject. The target is the next round, not the published same-row choice association.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Author BEH_ug.csv next-round choice after the frozen consecutive-round join; processed ERP columns are positionally joined and independently verified ERP event identity remains unresolved.
scientific_target.case_unit: One current participant:episode:round prefix followed by its next-round binary choice; a person is the evaluation episode.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Participant, with partner episodes and consecutive rounds dependent within person.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Descriptive held-person predictive contribution of supplied processed features for specified procedures, conditional on the positional ERP join; no physiological or causal effect.
exclusions: Same-row source-paper regression reproduction is calibration for a different temporal endpoint.
No causal ERP contribution, prospective online availability, or independent ERP-trial identity claim.
Seven exposed development people do not establish population confirmation.

inputs: Completed current-trial prefix: 50 history variables; optional three prestimulus ERP baselines (53 variables) and four offer ERP terms (57 variables total).
Training-only features and labels from 26 people / 3,254 training examples under the historical fixed panel; all views use common seven-ERP-complete support.
forbidden_inputs: Next-round choice, later prefixes or future rounds before prediction commitment.
Complete development table, source outcomes, private predictions, held-person labels or reference scores.
observation_contract.case_identity: Public cases.json fixes 816 participant:episode:round identities across seven people. The parser requires original episode 1..36 and current round 1..4; each identity appears once.
observation_contract.split: Historical 26-person training / seven-person exposed development scope; training-only tuning. Wider 41-person source does not authorize merging reserved people or treating the seven as pristine.
observation_contract.coverage: One task, three matched views, 2,448 predictions and 21 person/view protocols in the descriptive comparison. Static single-panel scorer accepts all 816 cases; it does not itself run all three candidate views or enforce chronology.

primary.name: equal_participant_all_erp_log_loss
primary.aggregation: Binary log loss in nats averaged within each of the seven people, then equally across people; existing clipping epsilon 1e-15 retained.
primary.rationale: Rewards calibrated predictions of recorded behavior; a large ERP-minus-history difference alone could be created by weakening history and must not replace absolute performance.

secondary: Brier score, per-person support and mean-probability calibration error; AUROC remains undefined for one-class people while they remain in primary loss.
All three absolute history/prestimulus/all-ERP losses and training-person-macro prior.
Paired history minus all-ERP, history minus prestimulus, and prestimulus minus all-ERP loss differences, including negative results.

comparators.name: training_participant_macro_prior
comparators.procedure: Existing contribution contract requires the equal-person training prior; no development prevalence fitting.

comparators.name: history / prestimulus / all_erp
comparators.inputs: Same training rows, same prefixes and nested 50/53/57-variable views.
comparators.procedure: Existing fixed references and matched-view adapter; candidate recipe/tuning must be held comparable across views, with each probability committed before next reveal.

nuisance_controls: Keep partner episode and round chronology; no adjacent-round random split.
Use common support checked before view masking; differences in missingness must not explain a view gain.
Exact within-person full-history randomization is infeasible: episode and round make all 816 strata singletons. Do not label an unchanged permutation a null test or substitute arbitrary bins.
Any future conditional ERP null needs a justified joint conditional distribution and sequential model fitted on training data.
evaluation.uncertainty: Retain all seven person differences and seven leave-one-person-out descriptive means. Current assessment supplies no calibrated interval or p-value; trials are not independent participants.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require every exact public identity once and finite numeric probability in [0,1] before private target decoding. Reject duplicate/missing/extra rows and fields. Do not discard failed people or manufacture a zero scientific score for operator failure.

implementation.scorer_target: grader.py validates the 816-case probability panel then scores actual next-round choices; scientific_contribution.assess checks a separately admitted complete matched-view report and computes descriptive loss differences. Neither validates the causal meaning of ERP features.
implementation.delivered_scope: Public scorer, strict probability arithmetic, fixed public case IDs and matched-report arithmetic exist. Historical manifest declares prefix-program developer controls; exact local assets/runtime and prefix delivery must be re-established before a new run.
missing: Authenticate ERP trial identity independently of positional concatenation.
Reconnect and qualify complete matched-view prefix execution, training provenance and source assets at the chosen operator environment.
Predeclare any broader cohort or genuine confirmation protocol without reusing exposed development labels.
implementation.execution_evidence: Historical manifest reports developer controls and saved metric checks; this revision inspected source only. The report adapter itself accepts authenticated inputs by contract and cannot prove their provenance.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed no-tools numeric current-prefix task using the same processed features, with each next-round probability committed before later prefix release.
direct_observation.boundary: Only current prefix and declared demonstrations; no reference predictions or future rounds.
missing: No delivered isolated no-tools response collector or matched direct-model run.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential typed plots of exactly the permitted processed ERP amplitudes and completed behavioral history. This would be visual interpretation of neural summaries, not raw EEG waveform interpretation.
typed_viewer.boundary: Render only the lawful current prefix; no next-round outcomes, later prefixes or hidden ERP source metadata. Changing to raw EEG would require independently aligned source epochs and a declared observation condition.
missing: No typed summary renderer, restricted participant transport or complete paired response collector for this task.

tool_assisted.representation: Proposed per-person sequential investigation of matched numeric prefixes with fixed numerical/model tools.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same view, training data and cumulative budget as the chosen comparator; no private feedback.
missing: Current static scorer and report adapter do not deliver a complete adaptive candidate episode.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted prefix predictor, applied fresh per held person; the public static scorer is a separate output consumer.
frozen_program.boundary: Historical source commitment and sequential reveal must be established by the separately bound runner; finished probability files do not establish this.
missing: Historical prefix programme is declared in manifest, but its complete runner/dependency closure is absent from the public task package; restore and qualify current execution.

evidence.supports: Exact 816-case target scoring and public validation before private decoding.
Equal-person probability losses and signed comparisons.
Next-round target, restricted current prefix and offline ERP limitations.
Historical programme controls and 26/7 scope; declarations are not new runtime qualification.
Matched view support and infeasible exact-history randomization.
Full-support report validation and descriptive estimand.

evidence.locator: Figure 2B analysis, lines 381–418; Figure 3 construction, lines 204–212
evidence.supports: Author same-row choice models and positional column concatenation; next-round prediction is an explicit extension. Reopened 2026-11-16.

summary: Makes recorded next-round behavior the known answer and identifies the difference from the published same-row endpoint.
Retains absolute loss as primary and explicitly disallows singleton history permutation as evidence for a neural contribution.
Separates the usable target scorer from report arithmetic and historically declared programme delivery.
revision.source_review: Inspected public target grader, metric implementation, complete matched-contribution adapter and historical runtime declaration; reopened the pinned author R analysis without reading data labels.
